top_signals.title: Herzog to Choose Between Eisenkot, Netanyahu on Sunday
top_signals.summary: Israel’s President Isaac Herzog says he will decide Sunday whether Benjamin Netanyahu or election challenger Gadi Eisenkot will get the first chance to form a governing coalition. Eisenkot has secured recommendations from 67 members of the 120-seat Knesset, compared with 46 for Netanyahu. Bloomberg’s Jerusalem reporter Dan Williams reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
